> For a while, I was a [police officer](/wiki/New_York_City_Police_Department_(Earth-616) "New York City Police Department (Earth-616)") myself. And so it was natural that I felt a certain way about [a cop killer on the loose](/wiki/Antony_Diaz_(Earth-616) "Antony Diaz (Earth-616)"). But this wasn't my mandate. This wasn't how I'd get back [the shield](/wiki/Captain_America%27s_Shield "Captain America's Shield"). I should have been chasing down the [Watchdogs](/wiki/Watchdogs_(Earth-616) "Watchdogs (Earth-616)") and [Power Enterprises](/wiki/Power_Elite_(Earth-616) "Power Elite (Earth-616)"). But [Larimore](/wiki/Angel_Larimore_(Earth-616) "Angel Larimore (Earth-616)") was dead. And the old officer in me got to talking. So I decided to walk my own path... not knowing that path would bring me full circle.

—[Steve Rogers](/wiki/Steven_Rogers_(Earth-616) "Steven Rogers (Earth-616)")

## Solicit Synopsis

“THE LEGEND OF STEVE” CONTINUES!

Steve Rogers’ mission to clear his reputation and to re-establish the good name of Captain America continues, as he and Jessica Drew, Spider-Woman, tackle a familiar old foe who is contaminating the water supply of a large rust-belt city!

Release Date: October 16, 2019
